hypotheses.claim: On dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms, replacing raw-magnitude removal-savings scoring with a median-normalized, size- and iteration-adaptive rank-power score (plus a depot-eccentricity x demand-efficiency gate) reduces mean objective below the current SBS of 16.0353, with the largest per-instance gains on the size=100 subset (12/12 currently exhausted) and on depot_style=eccentric, because normalization keeps the destroy set calibrated as the tour scale grows and the sharper exponent under stagnation increases iterations completed per budget.

next_search_advice.direction: Scale-invariant, n-adaptive ruin scoring: (1) divide removal_savings by a robust scale estimate (median absolute savings, floored) instead of raw magnitudes so scores transfer across n=50/100 and capacity levels; (2) make the rank-power exponent p grow with instance size n and with iter_frac/stagnation_ratio, so at n=100 (all 12 instances budget-exhausted) the destroy set concentrates on fewer, higher-leverage nodes, letting more LNS iterations fit in the fixed 500 ms budget; (3) add a multiplicative gate favoring nodes whose removal-merit per unit demand is high but whose distance from an eccentric depot is large, to relieve the weakest regime 'depot_style=eccentric' and 'capacity_level=loose' where worst-removal is blind to load structure. Keep deterministic tie-breaking by (score, index) and keep all state reads strictly read-only.
